name: Callout boxes (tcolorbox)
description: Reusable coloured note and warning boxes with titles. They break across pages.
notes: Define the box once with `\newtcolorbox` and the optional title argument `[1][Note]` sets a default.
`breakable` lets long boxes split across pages, and it needs `\tcbuselibrary{breakable}`.
Colours mix like `blue!55!black` (55% blue, 45% black). Keep backgrounds very light (`!4!white`).
